whatIs: Rare UI is a collection of more than 28 uncommon animated React components, such as a fluid orb, letters with gravity, sidebars with bounce or a duration picker. Each component is a single file that you add with the shadcn CLI or from its MCP server, and it ends up in your project for you to edit.
It's a good fit when you want an interface or a portfolio to have interaction details that stand out, without coding every animation from scratch.
uses: Giving a portfolio personality with an animated side menu and a counter that animates when it appears.
Showing the state of an AI assistant with an animated orb and a search-in-progress indicator.
Improving a verification form with an animated OTP code field and password field.
caveats: It's designed for React with Tailwind CSS and uses Motion for the animations, so it adds that dependency.
The license requires credit with a visible link to rareui.com in the project, for example in the footer or the README.
You can use it in commercial products, but you can't sell or redistribute the components as your own library or kit.
pricingNote: Free, including in commercial projects, under the MIT license plus the Commons Clause and a credit requirement.
idealFor: React portfolios and products that want rarely seen animated interactions.
